core_rules: Code operator status is not planning permission
Electronic Communications Code rights are distinct from planning rights
PDR category is not automatic site eligibility
Part 16 conditions and limitations must be checked
prior approval is not full planning permission
prior approval application is not prior approval granted
56-day procedure must not be converted into automatic site approval without conditions being met
mast height limits depend on current GPDO and site category
Article 2(3) land has different controls from unprotected land
SSSI restrictions must not be ignored
safeguarding notification is distinct from planning approval
defence asset safeguarding is not telecom permission
aerodrome safeguarding is not mast approval
NPPF ICNIRP self-certification is not a health permit
ICNIRP statement does not prove every operational exposure scenario
operator need should not be re-litigated as network-demand proof for parcel scoring
mast sharing policy is not evidence sharing is feasible on a specific structure
existing mast presence is not spare structural capacity
rooftop mast PDR does not prove landlord consent
Code rights do not automatically prove a private-land agreement exists
court-imposed Code agreement is not planning permission
access agreement is not planning permission
wayleave is not planning permission
street works immunity is not unrestricted construction permission
Ofcom Code register entry is not parcel apparatus location evidence
open Ofcom consultation is not final Code powers grant
final Code direction is not a site deployment decision
planning call for evidence is not adopted policy
consultation proposal must not be represented as law
2022 PDR amendment must be read with current GPDO text
wireless code of practice is best-practice guidance not statutory planning permission
community engagement is not approval
planning consultation is not approval
visual-impact mitigation statement is not design acceptance
building-regulations dispensation is distinct from planning permission
1 September 2026 telecom building directions must not be backdated
future dispensation is not current compliance
higher-risk-building telecom work can have distinct building-control requirements
fibre drilling dispensation does not authorise unrelated building work
network coverage map is not a planning permission map
mobile signal availability is not land-control evidence
Code powers consultation dates must be preserved
superseded operator status must not be assumed current
operator company identity must match current Ofcom register
NO_DATA must not become no telecom constraint
research confidence is not parcel telecom accuracy
no parcel mast approval land right or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
business rows remain zero until canonical recovery completes
